title: Rep. John McGuire Disclosed a Western Digital Sale, Down 18.9% Since
content:
Rep. John McGuire (VA-5) disclosed one stock sale on November 6, 2026: Western Digital (WDC), sold October 15 in the $1,001–$15,000 band.

Trade data: Bargo, compiled from U.S. House and Senate STOCK Act filings.

DateTickerCompanyType / sizePrice at trade vs. Nov 10 (Bargo est.)
Oct 15WDCWestern Digital CorporationSale, $1,001–$15,000$356.45 vs. $289.20 (−18.87%)

Transaction date: Oct 15, 2026. Disclosure date: Nov 6, 2026 (22 days later). Member: Rep. John McGuire, VA-5 (House).

What's been disclosed

  • One sale: Western Digital (WDC), $1,001–$15,000, on October 15.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts Western Digital about 18.9% lower on November 10 than on October 15.
  • Earlier filing: McGuire also disclosed a Micron (MU) purchase on November 1; see our earlier post.
  • Timing: the filing came 22 days after the trade, inside the 45-day window.

Quick FAQ

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
22 days after the trade, which was dated October 15. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the November 10 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.
